The Execution Reality

Projects do not fail from lack of activity.
They fail from weak execution evidence.

Most organisations can show that work is happening. Fewer can prove whether the plan is governed, the risk is visible, the spend is authorised, the impact is validated, and the lessons are reusable. Amaoru closes those gaps in one connected platform.

Governance drift
Plans, baselines, permissions, approvals, and ownership rules drift across teams without one governed execution layer.
Late risk
Schedule delay, workload pressure, dependency fragility, and blind spots often surface only after impact has already landed.
Value unproved
Spend, commitments, benefits, and outcomes are reported as activity, but not always tied to validated evidence and approval history.
Learning leakage
Lessons, decisions, and delivery patterns disappear after closure instead of strengthening the next project from initiation.

“Amaoru is built for leadership teams that need execution truth — not another activity dashboard, spreadsheet pack, or retrospective archive.”

Non-Negotiable Guardrails

The platform governs itself.
No exceptions. No overrides.

These are not configuration options. They are platform-level commitments enforced at every layer — service, query, route, and AI boundary.

🔒
Tenant Isolation
Enforced in every service and query. Tenant context is always explicit — never inferred. No cross-tenant data leakage is architecturally possible.
👥
RBAC & Permissions
Admin · Supervisor · Employee · Project Supervisor (Responsibility). Role gates enforced before any action — no privilege escalation possible.
📋
Full Audit Trail
Every action is recorded with actor, timestamp, and context. No action occurs without a corresponding audit entry — governance is not optional.
📐
Approved Baseline
Immutable source before edits. No schedule performance, budget comparison, or earned-value calculation runs without an approved, locked baseline.
🔢
Data Integrity
No invented figures. No overrides. Budget, commitment, and schedule data comes from governed, approved records only — never inferred by AI.
🚫
No AI Overrides
AI cannot baseline, validate, approve, close, delete, or invent figures. Ask Me is advisory and read-only. Humans make every governed decision.
